scripts.dev: node packages/shared/scripts/sync-dist.mjs && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c yellow,blue,green "npm run watch -w @toeic/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @toeic/api" "npm run dev -w @toeic/web"
scripts.dev:web: node packages/shared/scripts/sync-dist.mjs && concurrently -n shared,web -c yellow,green "npm run watch -w @toeic/shared" "npm run dev -w @toeic/web"
scripts.dev:api: node packages/shared/scripts/sync-dist.mjs && concurrently -n shared,api -c yellow,blue "npm run watch -w @toeic/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @toeic/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @toeic/shared && npm run build -w @toeic/api && npm run build -w @toeic/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @toeic/shared && npm run test -w @toeic/api && npm run test -w @toeic/web
